jobs.title: UKSSSC Sub Inspector & Platoon Commander 2026: 200 Posts
jobs.summary: Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (Advt No. 85/2026) has notified 200 uniformed Group C posts: SI Civil Police 93, SI Intelligence 19, Platoon Commander 81, Fire Station Second Officer 5 and Sub Excise Inspector 2. Graduates (12th pass for Sub Excise Inspector) can apply online from 1 to 31 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Graduate in any discipline (SI, SI Intelligence, Platoon Commander - male only); science graduate (Fire Station Second Officer); Intermediate (Sub Excise Inspector); Uttarakhand domicile or Uttarakhand employment-office registration
Age: 21-35 years (Sub Excise Inspector 21-42) as on 01-07-2026; Uttarakhand SC/ST/OBC +5 years
Pay: Rs 44,900-1,42,400 (Level 7); Sub Excise Inspector Rs 29,200-92,300 (Level 5)
Fee: UR/OBC Rs 300; Uttarakhand SC/ST/EWS Rs 150; Orphan nil
Selection: PST and PET, then 200-mark offline objective exam (1/4 negative marking), merit, medical and document check
Dates: apply 01 Dec - 31 Dec 2026; correction 04-06 Jan 2027; written exam 18 Apr 2027 (tentative)

jobs.title: NMDC Kirandul Apprentice 2026: 247 Seats (Walk-in)
jobs.summary: NMDC Limited, Bailadila Iron Ore Mine Kirandul Complex (KC/T & S/2026) will hold walk-in interviews for 247 apprentice seats: 172 Trade, 55 Graduate and 20 Technician (Diploma) apprentices. Walk-in dates run from 14 to 22 December 2026 at Kirandul.
lines: Eligibility: Trade - 10th with ITI in the trade; Graduate - full-time degree in the discipline (Chemical, Computer, Electrical, EEE, Mechanical, Mining, Civil Engg, B.Pharm, BBA); Diploma - full-time diploma; NAPS/NATS registration required; result-awaited and those with over 1 year experience not eligible
Age: minimum 18 years as on the date of notification
Pay: Stipend as per Apprenticeship Rules, 1992
Selection: Walk-in interview and document verification
Dates: walk-in 14-22 Dec 2026 (graduate apprentices 19, 21 and 22 Dec), report before 1 PM

jobs.title: NTA Office Assistant 2026: 15 Contract Posts
jobs.summary: National Testing Agency has invited applications for 15 Office Assistant posts at its New Delhi head office on a five-year contract. Graduates in any discipline can apply by email within two weeks of the advertisement.
lines: Eligibility: Graduate in any discipline with working knowledge of computers and good English and Hindi; office experience desirable
Pay: equivalent to Pay Level 4 of 7th CPC
Selection: scrutiny of applications and personal interaction/interview
Dates: apply by email to recruitment@nta.ac.in within 2 weeks of the advertisement (around 9 Dec 2026)
